# Class of service

`customer_support.df.queue_management.class_of_service` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **decision_framework**

> Class of service — declare named classes of work (aged, entitled, blocking, routine) and a published order between them.

It converts prioritisation from a thousand individual judgements under pressure into one reviewable policy. It also makes exceptions visible, which is the only way a standing exception ever gets challenged.
